title: Blind to the Human Touch: Overlap Bias in LLM-Based Summary Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM judge preferences between LLM-generated summaries and human-written summaries across varying degrees of n-gram similarity (ROUGE, BLEU) to measure favoritism towards machine-generated text.
Presenting evaluated summaries in both forward and reverse orders to track if the LLM judge consistently selects the first-presented or last-presented summary regardless of the actual content.
